flows.name: Tag incidents for DLP review
flows.description: Adds review tags, moves incidents to in progress, and includes the latest privacy-safe Detection Assurance priority and security comment when available.

flows.name: Email affected users
flows.description: Sends a redacted DLP awareness message to every affected user.

flows.name: Notify affected users in Teams
flows.description: Lets an administrator send a reviewed, redacted notification to affected users through one-to-one Microsoft Teams chats.

parameters.name: teamsRecipients
parameters.label: Teams recipients (optional)
parameters.help: Comma-separated Microsoft Entra user principal names. Leave blank to use affected users from the selected DLP scope.

parameters.name: teamsMessage
parameters.label: Teams notification
parameters.default: Please review the data protection activity associated with your account. Sensitive values are not included in this notification.
parameters.help: Review before sending. Detected values are never inserted automatically.
